chapter.series: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan
chapter.source: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan 1-2 - bundle

summary: Ghislain demands command from Skovan during the orc attack, is refused, and instead wins the troops' momentum by fighting the orcs alone, cutting them down at their weak spots until Skovan realises he is running them toward a cliff. Skovan follows the plan, the shield wall pushes the orcs off the cliff, but Ghislain falls, hanging from his sword before his grip gives way. As he falls, shattered memories of Elena surface, and he wakes alive in bed, in pain from pushing his body to its limit. Belinda, his personal tutor, rushes in, and he tries to warn her that a catastrophe will soon strike Perdium and that he died and came back to life, but she does not believe him. Her mention of the festival with Lady Elena instead leaves him with one week until the day that changed his life, when Elena will die.

characters.name: Ghislain
characters.description: The first son, who fights the orcs alone to give the troops momentum, falls from the cliff, and wakes in bed to warn Belinda about Perdium.

characters.name: Skovan
characters.description: The troops' commander, who refuses Ghislain command, watches his fighting in disbelief, and then follows his cliff plan.

characters.name: Elena
characters.description: The young woman from Ghislain's memories who calls him 'oppa' and has been waiting to go to the festival with him.

characters.name: Belinda
characters.description: Ghislain's personal tutor, who rushes to his bedside when he wakes and does not believe his warning about Perdium.

voice_beats.narration: On the battlefield, Ghislain stands over the fallen commander and demands the right to command. Skovan is stunned that he would ask for that while their soldiers' lives are on the line, and he flatly refuses, saying he cannot hand over the authority the lord gave him, and walks away.
voice_beats.visual_description: Ghislain stands over the fallen, armoured Skovan and demands command; Skovan glares back, then turns and walks away.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Ghislain watching Skovan leave as the battle turns.

voice_beats.narration: Ghislain is annoyed, though he admits he would have reacted the same way. Then a huge orc charges at them, roaring, and Skovan orders him to fall back, saying he is still too inexperienced to lead the troops. Ghislain decides he has no choice and readies his sword instead of retreating.
voice_beats.visual_description: Ghislain's annoyed face; a huge red orc charges at the two men; Skovan pushes Ghislain back; Ghislain raises his sword.
voice_beats.transition: Hard cut to Ghislain charging forward.

voice_beats.narration: He charges past a stunned Skovan toward the orc, and Skovan grabs him, shouting and demanding to know what he thinks he is doing. But Skovan freezes at what he is seeing: the orc stands with a sword driven through its head, then crashes to the ground, dead.
voice_beats.visual_description: Ghislain dashes past Skovan, who grabs and shouts at him; Skovan's face freezes in confusion; the orc stands with a sword through its head and dies.
voice_beats.transition: Hold on Skovan's stunned face as the dust settles.

voice_beats.narration: Skovan stares in disbelief, wondering how Ghislain hit its weak spot. Ghislain turns to him and asks, 'Skovan, right? Do you know what the most important thing in battle is?' More orcs roar forward while the soldiers tremble behind their shields. His answer is blunt: there is no hope of winning when the troops are filled with fear — they need momentum.
voice_beats.visual_description: The dead orc with Ghislain's sword in it; Skovan stammers in shock; Ghislain questions him; roaring orcs advance on trembling soldiers; Ghislain's determined face.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Ghislain moving to attack the orcs himself.

voice_beats.narration: He cuts into another orc as Skovan watches, then leaps into the middle of the orcs with his sword raised while the soldiers look on below. He drives his sword into one more, then stands on the fallen orc, blade bloodied, and taunts them: 'Come at me, orcs... I'll kill all of you!'
voice_beats.visual_description: Ghislain slashes an orc, leaps high above the orc pack, drives his sword down into one, and stands on the fallen orc shouting his challenge.
voice_beats.transition: Widen to the orcs closing in around him.

voice_beats.narration: The orcs close in around him, and Skovan watches in disbelief, wondering if he is dreaming. Even as a mana user, he says, it is hard for him to do anything — so how is the skinny young master doing all of this?
voice_beats.visual_description: Orcs surround Ghislain as he fights among them; Skovan stares, stunned, as Ghislain cuts an orc down.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Skovan studying Ghislain's fighting up close.

voice_beats.narration: Skovan can already tell Ghislain is tired and panting hard. However, he realises Ghislain is dodging with the smallest movements and striking at weak spots with his swordsmanship, like a manaless sword master — or perhaps even something greater.
voice_beats.visual_description: An exhausted, bloodied Ghislain panting as Skovan watches; Ghislain dodges an orc's blow by a hair and strikes its weak spot; a shadowy armoured figure looms behind him.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Ghislain taunting the orcs again.

voice_beats.narration: Ghislain laughs at the orcs and taunts them, asking if that is all they have got, because he is still not warmed up, and mocking them for not living up to their reputation as a warrior species. But the soldiers panic as all the orcs charge at him, wondering if he is running away.
voice_beats.visual_description: Ghislain grins and shouts his taunt as orcs attack him; panicking soldiers watch all the orcs charge at the young master.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Skovan stepping forward as the soldiers cry out.

voice_beats.narration: The soldiers call out to their commander as Skovan steps forward, wondering what Ghislain is thinking. Running into the orcs and drawing their attention was good, Skovan thinks — but running away now?
voice_beats.visual_description: Soldiers shout for their commander as Skovan walks forward; Skovan's grim profile as he weighs what Ghislain is doing.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to the view in the direction Ghislain is running.

voice_beats.narration: And in that direction lies the edge of a cliff. Skovan realises it with a jolt: a cliff? 'D-don't tell me...!' He orders the troops to raise a shield wall and decides to follow the first son's lead.
voice_beats.visual_description: A wide view of the town and castle below a cliff edge; Skovan's eye widens in realisation; he orders the shield wall and resolves to follow the first son.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to the orcs thundering after Ghislain.

voice_beats.narration: The orcs thunder after Ghislain as he runs ahead of them. He is certain a skilled commander like Skovan has already realised the plan. He would prefer to cut them all down himself, but his stamina cannot handle that — what he has done should be enough for the troops.
voice_beats.visual_description: Orcs chase the small figure of Ghislain; Ghislain glances back with his sword ready; he fights the orcs at the cliff's edge and smiles.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to the orcs charging into the trap.

voice_beats.narration: The pursuing orcs charge on, then check in surprise as Skovan and the troops hold their shield wall, spears ready. Ghislain smiles. 'Perfect.' And leaps off the cliff edge as the orcs look on from above.
voice_beats.visual_description: Orcs rush forward and stop short at the shield wall; the troops advance with spears; Ghislain smiles and leaps off the cliff.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Ghislain falling as he gives the signal.

voice_beats.narration: Falling, Ghislain gives the signal: 'Now.' Skovan shouts for the troops to push the orcs off the cliff, and the shield formation advances on them at the edge, driving into the orcs as they shout and push them back.
voice_beats.visual_description: Ghislain falls with his sword in hand; Skovan roars the order; the shield wall drives into the orcs at the cliff edge.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to the orcs going over the edge.

voice_beats.narration: The orcs are hurled off the cliff, plummeting and crashing below, and the breathless soldiers realise they managed to kill all those orcs.
voice_beats.visual_description: Orcs tumble off the cliff and crash far below; the soldiers stand panting at the edge, realising they did it.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Skovan rushing to the cliff edge.

voice_beats.narration: But Skovan rushes to the cliff's edge, shouting for the young master. Below, Ghislain is hanging from his sword, driven into the cliff face, holding on with a faint smile on his bloodied face.
voice_beats.visual_description: Skovan and the soldiers rush to the edge shouting; Ghislain dangles from his sword stuck in the cliff, smiling faintly.
voice_beats.transition: Hold on Skovan's shocked face as he leans over.

voice_beats.narration: Skovan stares down at him in shock and leans over the edge, calling out, 'Here, grab my hand!' But Ghislain's hand slips from the sword as he admits, 'I can't...' He falls away while Skovan reaches out, shouting for him to hold on.
voice_beats.visual_description: Skovan stares down in shock and reaches over the edge; Ghislain's fingers slip from his sword; he falls away as Skovan reaches for him.
voice_beats.transition: Fade to darkness as Ghislain falls.

voice_beats.narration: Skovan shouts for the young master as Ghislain falls into darkness, and a voice calls, 'Oppa...' It is Elena, calling, 'Ghislain oppa,' and Ghislain whispers, 'Elena...?'
voice_beats.visual_description: A shout echoes over empty sky; darkness closes in; a girl's face appears calling his name; Ghislain stares back in the dark.
voice_beats.transition: Dissolve into the shattered memories.

voice_beats.narration: Shattered memories flash past: a child asking if their mother is gone, thanking him, then angrily turning on him. Ghislain stands alone in the darkness, holding a fragment of those memories, and realises they are his memories of Elena — until she grabs him and pleads, 'Let's go together!'
voice_beats.visual_description: Memory fragments float in the dark: a child Elena hugging him, thanking him, then shouting at him; Ghislain alone holding a glowing shard; Elena grabs his arm and pleads.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Ghislain waking in bed.

voice_beats.narration: Ghislain wakes in bed, a cloth on his forehead, his eyes opening, and lies alone in the quiet room. He realises he is alive, and that they managed to save him. Sitting up, he wonders if it was a dream, but pain jolts through him: his whole body hurts from pushing himself to the limit — and the pain tells him he is still alive.
voice_beats.visual_description: Ghislain opens his eyes in bed with a damp cloth on his forehead; the quiet room from above; he sits up wincing as pain shoots through his body.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to the doorway as someone enters.

voice_beats.narration: A figure enters the doorway, calling him 'Master?' Belinda rushes in, exclaiming that he is awake, and Ghislain recognises her: 'Belinda...?' She scolds him for not leaving the orcs to the soldiers, then Ghislain pulls her into a hug. Startled, she asks what he is doing, and he answers that he is just glad to see her.
voice_beats.visual_description: A dark figure in the doorway; Belinda rushes in, delighted; Ghislain stares at her; she scolds him, then he pulls her into a sudden hug.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Ghislain's thoughts about who Belinda is to him.

voice_beats.narration: Belinda is his personal tutor, the only one who stayed by his side since he was little despite his idiotic antics. But after his family fell to ruins and she went missing, he could no longer see her, and he never thought he would see her like this — while she wonders why he is so happy when they see each other every day. He resolves to tell her the truth.
voice_beats.visual_description: Belinda kneels to help the young Ghislain; a single worn shoe lies in the ruins; Belinda looks puzzled in his arms; Ghislain's determined eyes.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Ghislain warning her about Perdium.

voice_beats.narration: He tells her to listen carefully: a catastrophe will soon strike Perdium. 'The truth is... I died and came back to life...' But Belinda brushes it off, joking that the orcs almost killed him, and warns him that he, not Perdium, is in greater danger if he keeps causing scenes. Ghislain concludes she does not believe him.
voice_beats.visual_description: Ghislain holds Belinda's shoulders and warns her; his mouth forms the words; Belinda laughs it off; she scolds him as he stands defeated.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Belinda changing the subject to the festival.

voice_beats.narration: Belinda asks what he would have done if he had been too hurt to even go to the festival. Ghislain repeats, puzzled, 'Festival...?' She reminds him Lady Elena has been waiting to go to the festival with him, a great chance for the two of them to become close again, as he picks up a framed photograph.
voice_beats.visual_description: Belinda scolds him about the festival; Ghislain's eye narrows in confusion; Belinda explains about Lady Elena; a framed photograph of the two children on a shelf.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to Ghislain looking at the photograph.

voice_beats.narration: He remembers a festival always happened around this time of year, though in his past life he never had time for festivals because of a traumatic experience. He asks how long until the festival, and Belinda says it is next week, so he has about a week left. Ghislain quietly echoes, 'Week...'
voice_beats.visual_description: Ghislain holds the framed photograph; a lone figure kneels in a ruined room; Ghislain asks Belinda how long until the festival; he turns away, repeating the word.
voice_beats.transition: Cut to the doorway and the voice from his memory.

voice_beats.narration: His thoughts turn to the day that changed his life, as a voice at a doorway asks, 'Oppa, are you inside...?' He calls it the memory that continues to haunt him, as Elena pleads with him: 'Please go with me!' And the chapter closes on a chilling reveal: one week later, Elena will die.
voice_beats.visual_description: Small shoes at a doorway as a voice calls in; Ghislain's haunted profile; Elena pleads with him, clutching his sleeve; Elena at the door beneath the words that she will die in one week.
